texts.610.11: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth;
texts.610.12: If thy children will keep my covenant
texts.610.14: This is my resting-place for ever:
texts.610.15: I will abundantly bless her provision:
texts.610.16: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation;
texts.610.17: There will I make the horn of David to bud:
texts.610.18: His enemies will I clothe with shame;
texts.611.1: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is
texts.611.2: It is like the precious oil upon the head,
texts.612.1: Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah,
texts.612.2: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary,
texts.612.3: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion;
texts.613.2: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah,
texts.613.3: Praise ye Jehovah; for Jehovah is good:
texts.613.4: For Jehovah hath chosen Jacob unto himself,
texts.613.5: For I know that Jehovah is great,
texts.613.6: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done,
texts.613.7: Who causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth;
texts.613.8: Who smote the first-born of Egypt,
texts.613.9: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt,
texts.613.12: And gave their land for a heritage,
texts.613.13: Thy name, O Jehovah, endureth for ever;
texts.613.14: For Jehovah will judge his people,
texts.613.15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
texts.613.16: They have mouths, but they speak not;
texts.613.17: They have ears, but they hear not;
texts.613.18: They that make them shall be like unto them;
texts.613.19: O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah:
texts.613.20: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah:
texts.613.21: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion,
texts.614.1: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good;
texts.614.2: Oh give thanks unto the God of gods;
texts.614.3: Oh give thanks unto the Lord of lords;
texts.614.4: To him who alone doeth great wonders;
texts.614.5: To him that by understanding made the heavens;
texts.614.6: To him that spread forth the earth above the waters;
texts.614.7: To him that made great lights;
texts.614.8: The sun to rule by day;
texts.614.9: The moon and stars to rule by night;
texts.614.10: To him that smote Egypt in their first-born;
texts.614.11: And brought out Israel from among them;
texts.614.12: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm;
texts.614.13: To him that divided the Red Sea in sunder;
texts.614.14: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it;
texts.614.15: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea;
texts.614.16: To him that led his people through the wilderness;
texts.614.17: To him that smote great kings;
texts.614.21: And gave their land for a heritage;
texts.614.22: Even a heritage unto Israel his servant;
texts.614.23: Who remembered us in our low estate;
texts.614.24: And hath delivered us from our adversaries;
texts.614.25: Who giveth food to all flesh;
texts.614.26: Oh give thanks unto the God of heaven;
texts.615.2: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.
texts.615.3: For there they that led us captive required of us songs,
texts.615.4: How shall we sing Jehovah's song
texts.615.5: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem,
texts.615.6: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth,
texts.615.7: Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom
texts.615.8: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed,
texts.615.9: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones
texts.616.1: I will give thee thanks with my whole heart:
texts.616.2: I will worship toward thy holy temple,
texts.616.3: In the day that I called thou answeredst me,
texts.616.4: All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah,
texts.616.5: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah;
texts.616.6: For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly;
texts.616.7: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me;
texts.616.8: Jehovah will perfect that which concerneth me:
texts.617.1: O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known me.
texts.617.2: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising;
texts.617.3: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down,
texts.617.4: For there is not a word in my tongue,
texts.617.5: Thou hast beset me behind and before,
texts.617.6: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me;
texts.617.7: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit?
texts.617.8: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there:
texts.617.9: If I take the wings of the morning,
texts.617.10: Even there shall thy hand lead me,
texts.617.11: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me,
texts.617.12: Even the darkness hideth not from thee,
texts.617.13: For thou didst form my inward parts:
texts.617.14: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully
texts.617.15: My frame was not hidden from thee,
texts.617.16: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance;
texts.617.17: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God!
texts.617.18: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand:
texts.617.19: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God:
texts.617.20: For they speak against thee wickedly,
texts.617.21: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee?
texts.617.22: I hate them with perfect hatred:
texts.617.23: Search me, O God, and know my heart:
texts.617.24: And see if there be any wicked way in me,
texts.618.1: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from the evil man;
texts.618.2: Who devise mischiefs in their heart;
texts.618.3: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent;
texts.618.4: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked;
texts.618.5: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords;
texts.618.6: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God:
texts.618.7: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation,
texts.618.8: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked;
texts.618.9: As for the head of those that compass me about,
texts.618.10: Let burning coals fall upon them:
texts.618.11: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth:
texts.618.12: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted,
texts.618.13: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name:
texts.619.1: Jehovah, I have called upon thee; make haste unto me:
texts.619.2: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee;
texts.619.3: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth;
texts.619.4: Incline not my heart to any evil thing,
texts.619.5: Let the righteous smite me, it shall be a kindness;
texts.619.6: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock;
texts.619.7: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth,
texts.619.8: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord:
texts.619.9: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me,
texts.619.10: Let the wicked fall into their own nets,
texts.620.1: I cry with my voice unto Jehovah;
texts.620.2: I pour out my complaint before him;
texts.620.3: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me,
texts.620.4: Look on my right hand, and see;
texts.620.5: I cried unto thee, O Jehovah;
texts.620.7: Bring my soul out of prison,
texts.621.1: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications:
texts.621.2: And enter not into judgment with thy servant;
texts.621.3: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul;
texts.621.4: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me;
texts.621.5: I remember the days of old;
texts.621.6: I spread forth my hands unto thee:
texts.621.7: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth:
texts.621.8: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning;
texts.621.9: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies:
texts.621.10: Teach me to do thy will;
texts.621.11: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name's sake:
texts.621.12: And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies,
texts.622.3: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him?
texts.622.5: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down:
texts.622.6: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them;
texts.622.7: Stretch forth thy hand from above;
texts.622.9: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God:
texts.622.10: Thou art he that giveth salvation unto kings;
texts.622.11: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens,
texts.622.12: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth,
texts.622.13: When our garners are full, affording all manner of store,
texts.622.14: When our oxen are well laden;
texts.622.15: Happy is the people that is in such a case;
texts.623.1: I will extol thee, my God, O King;
texts.623.2: Every day will I bless thee;
texts.623.3: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised;
texts.623.4: One generation shall laud thy works to another,
texts.623.5: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor,
texts.623.6: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts;
texts.623.7: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness,
texts.623.10: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah;
texts.623.11: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom,
texts.623.12: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts,
texts.623.13: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom,
texts.623.15: The eyes of all wait for thee;
texts.623.17: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways,
texts.623.18: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him,
texts.623.19: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him;
texts.623.20: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him;
texts.623.21: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah;
texts.624.2: While I live will I praise Jehovah:
texts.624.3: Put not your trust in princes,
texts.624.4: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth;
texts.624.5: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help,
texts.624.7: Who executeth justice for the oppressed;
texts.624.8: Jehovah openeth the eyes of the blind;
texts.625.3: He healeth the broken in heart,
texts.625.4: He counteth the number of the stars;
texts.625.5: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power;
texts.625.8: Who covereth the heavens with clouds,
texts.625.9: He giveth to the beast his food,
texts.625.10: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse:
texts.625.11: Jehovah taketh pleasure in them that fear him,
texts.625.13: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates;
texts.625.14: He maketh peace in thy borders;
texts.625.15: He sendeth out his commandment upon earth;
texts.625.17: He casteth forth his ice like morsels:
texts.625.18: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them:
texts.625.19: He showeth his word unto Jacob,
texts.625.20: He hath not dealt so with any nation;
texts.626.2: Praise ye him, all his angels:
texts.626.3: Praise ye him, sun and moon:
texts.626.4: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens,
texts.626.5: Let them praise the name of Jehovah;
texts.626.6: He hath also established them for ever and ever:
texts.626.8: Fire and hail, snow and vapor;
texts.626.11: Kings of the earth and all peoples;
texts.626.13: Let them praise the name of Jehovah;
texts.626.14: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people,
texts.627.2: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him:
texts.627.3: Let them praise his name in the dance:
texts.627.4: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people:
texts.627.5: Let the saints exult in glory:
texts.627.6: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth,
texts.627.7: To execute vengeance upon the nations,
texts.627.8: To bind their kings with chains,
texts.627.9: To execute upon them the judgment written:
texts.628.2: Praise him for his mighty acts:
texts.628.4: Praise him with timbrel and dance:
texts.628.6: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah.
texts.629.1: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:
texts.629.3: To receive instruction in wise dealing,
texts.629.4: To give prudence to the simple,
texts.629.5: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning;
texts.629.6: To understand a proverb, and a figure,
texts.629.7: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge;
texts.629.8: My son, hear the instruction of thy father,
texts.629.9: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head,
texts.629.10: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.
texts.629.11: If they say, Come with us,
texts.629.12: Let us swallow them up alive as Sheol,
texts.629.13: We shall find all precious substance;
texts.629.14: Thou shalt cast thy lot among us;
texts.629.15: My son, walk not thou in the way with them;
texts.629.16: For their feet run to evil,
texts.629.17: For in vain is the net spread
texts.629.18: And these lay wait for their own blood;
texts.629.19: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain;
texts.629.20: Wisdom crieth aloud in the street;
texts.629.21: She crieth in the chief place of concourse;
texts.629.22: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity?
texts.629.24: Because I have called, and ye have refused;
texts.629.25: But ye have set at nought all my counsel,
texts.629.26: I also will laugh in the day of your calamity;
texts.629.27: When your fear cometh as a storm,
texts.629.28: Then will they call upon me, but I will not answer;
texts.629.30: They would none of my counsel;
texts.629.31: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way,
texts.629.32: For the backsliding of the simple shall slay them,
texts.629.33: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell securely,
texts.630.1: My son, if thou wilt receive my words,
texts.630.2: So as to incline thine ear unto wisdom,
texts.630.3: Yea, if thou cry after discernment,
texts.630.4: If thou seek her as silver,
texts.630.5: Then shalt thou understand the fear of Jehovah,
texts.630.7: He layeth up sound wisdom for the upright;
texts.630.8: That he may guard the paths of justice,
texts.630.9: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and justice,
texts.630.10: For wisdom shall enter into thy heart,
texts.630.12: To deliver thee from the way of evil,
texts.630.13: Who forsake the paths of uprightness,
texts.630.15: Who are crooked in their ways,
texts.630.16: To deliver thee from the strange woman,
texts.630.17: That forsaketh the friend of her youth,
texts.630.18: For her house inclineth unto death,
texts.630.19: None that go unto her return again,
texts.630.20: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men,
texts.630.21: For the upright shall dwell in the land,
texts.630.22: But the wicked shall be cut off from the land,
texts.631.1: My son, forget not my law;
texts.631.2: For length of days, and years of life,
texts.631.3: Let not kindness and truth forsake thee:
texts.631.4: So shalt thou find favor and good understanding
texts.631.5: Trust in Jehovah with all thy heart,
texts.631.6: In all thy ways acknowledge him,
texts.631.7: Be not wise in thine own eyes;
texts.631.8: It will be health to thy navel,
texts.631.10: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty,
texts.631.11: My son, despise not the chastening of Jehovah;
texts.631.12: For whom Jehovah loveth he reproveth;
texts.631.13: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom,
texts.631.14: For the gaining of it is better than the gaining of silver,
texts.631.15: She is more precious than rubies:
texts.631.16: Length of days is in her right hand;
texts.631.17: Her ways are ways of pleasantness,
texts.631.18: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her:
texts.631.19: Jehovah by wisdom founded the earth;
texts.631.20: By his knowledge the depths were broken up,
texts.631.21: My son, let them not depart from thine eyes;
texts.631.22: So shall they be life unto thy soul,
texts.631.23: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely,
texts.631.24: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid:
texts.631.25: Be not afraid of sudden fear,
texts.631.26: For Jehovah will be thy confidence,
texts.631.27: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due,
texts.631.28: Say not unto thy neighbor, Go, and come again,
texts.631.29: Devise not evil against thy neighbor,
texts.631.30: Strive not with a man without cause,
texts.631.31: Envy thou not the man of violence,
texts.631.32: For the perverse is an abomination to Jehovah;
texts.631.33: The curse of Jehovah is in the house of the wicked;
texts.631.34: Surely he scoffeth at the scoffers;
texts.632.1: Hear, my sons, the instruction of a father,
texts.632.2: For I give you good doctrine;
texts.632.3: For I was a son unto my father,
texts.632.4: And he taught me, and said unto me:
texts.632.6: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee;
texts.632.7: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom;
texts.632.8: Exalt her, and she will promote thee;
texts.632.9: She will give to thy head a chaplet of grace;
texts.632.10: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings;
texts.632.11: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom;
texts.632.12: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened;
texts.632.13: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go:
texts.632.14: Enter not into the path of the wicked,
texts.632.15: Avoid it, pass not by it;
texts.632.16: For they sleep not, except they do evil;
texts.632.17: For they eat the bread of wickedness,
texts.632.18: But the path of the righteous is as the dawning light,
texts.632.19: The way of the wicked is as darkness:
texts.632.20: My son, attend to my words;
texts.632.21: Let them not depart from thine eyes;
texts.632.22: For they are life unto those that find them,
texts.632.23: Keep thy heart with all diligence;
texts.632.24: Put away from thee a wayward mouth,
texts.632.25: Let thine eyes look right on,
texts.632.26: Make level the path of thy feet,
texts.632.27: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left:
texts.633.1: My son, attend unto my wisdom;
texts.633.3: For the lips of a strange woman drop honey,
texts.633.4: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood,
texts.633.5: Her feet go down to death;
texts.633.6: So that she findeth not the level path of life:
texts.633.7: Now therefore, my sons, hearken unto me,
texts.633.8: Remove thy way far from her,
texts.633.9: Lest thou give thine honor unto others,
texts.633.10: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength,
texts.633.11: And thou mourn at thy latter end,
texts.633.12: And say, How have I hated instruction,
texts.633.13: Neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers,
texts.633.14: I was well-nigh in all evil
texts.633.15: Drink waters out of thine own cistern,
texts.633.16: Should thy springs be dispersed abroad,
texts.633.17: Let them be for thyself alone,
texts.633.19: As a loving hind and a pleasant doe,
texts.633.20: For why shouldest thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman,
texts.633.21: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Jehovah;
texts.633.22: His own iniquities shall take the wicked,
texts.633.23: He shall die for lack of instruction;
texts.634.1: My son, if thou art become surety for thy neighbor,
texts.634.2: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth,
texts.634.3: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself,
texts.634.4: Give not sleep to thine eyes,
texts.634.5: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter,
texts.634.6: Go to the ant, thou sluggard;
texts.634.8: Provideth her bread in the summer,
texts.634.9: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard?
texts.634.10: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber,
texts.634.11: So shall thy poverty come as a robber,
texts.634.12: A worthless person, a man of iniquity,
texts.634.13: That winketh with his eyes, that speaketh with his feet,
texts.634.15: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly;
texts.634.16: There are six things which Jehovah hateth;
texts.634.18: A heart that deviseth wicked purposes,
texts.634.19: A false witness that uttereth lies,
texts.634.20: My son, keep the commandment of thy father,
texts.634.21: Bind them continually upon thy heart;
texts.634.22: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee;
texts.634.23: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light;
texts.634.24: To keep thee from the evil woman,
texts.634.25: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart;
texts.634.26: For on account of a harlot a man is brought to a piece of bread;
texts.634.27: Can a man take fire in his bosom,
texts.634.28: Or can one walk upon hot coals,
texts.634.29: So he that goeth in to his neighbor's wife;
texts.634.30: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal
texts.634.31: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold;
texts.634.32: He that committeth adultery with a woman is void of understanding:
texts.634.33: Wounds and dishonor shall he get;
texts.634.34: For jealousy is the rage of a man;
texts.634.35: He will not regard any ransom;
texts.635.4: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister;
texts.635.5: That they may keep thee from the strange woman,
texts.635.6: For at the window of my house
texts.635.7: And I beheld among the simple ones,
texts.635.8: Passing through the street near her corner;
texts.635.9: In the twilight, in the evening of the day,
texts.635.10: And, behold, there met him a woman
texts.635.12: Now she is in the streets, now in the broad places,
texts.635.13: So she caught him, and kissed him,
texts.635.14: Sacrifices of peace-offerings are with me;
texts.635.15: Therefore came I forth to meet thee,
texts.635.16: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry,
texts.635.18: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning;
texts.635.19: For the man is not at home;
texts.635.20: He hath taken a bag of money with him;
texts.635.21: With her much fair speech she causeth him to yield;
texts.635.23: Till an arrow strike through his liver;
texts.635.24: Now therefore, my sons, hearken unto me,
texts.635.25: Let not thy heart decline to her ways;
texts.635.26: For she hath cast down many wounded:
texts.635.27: Her house is the way to Sheol,
texts.636.2: On the top of high places by the way,
texts.636.3: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city,
texts.636.4: Unto you, O men, I call;
texts.636.6: Hear, for I will speak excellent things;
texts.636.7: For my mouth shall utter truth;
texts.636.8: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness;
texts.636.9: They are all plain to him that understandeth,
texts.636.10: Receive my instruction, and not silver;
texts.636.11: For wisdom is better than rubies;
texts.636.12: I wisdom have made prudence my dwelling,
texts.636.13: The fear of Jehovah is to hate evil:
texts.636.14: Counsel is mine, and sound knowledge:
texts.636.17: I love them that love me;
texts.636.18: Riches and honor are with me;
texts.636.19: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold;
texts.636.20: I walk in the way of righteousness,
texts.636.21: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance,
texts.636.22: Jehovah possessed me in the beginning of his way,
texts.636.23: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning,
texts.636.24: When there were no depths, I was brought forth,
texts.636.26: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields,
texts.636.27: When he established the heavens, I was there:
texts.636.28: When he made firm the skies above,
texts.636.29: When he gave to the sea its bound,
texts.636.30: Then I was by him, as a master workman;
texts.636.32: Now therefore, my sons, hearken unto me;
texts.636.34: Blessed is the man that heareth me,
texts.636.35: For whoso findeth me findeth life,
